agent_explanation: Body falls diagonally (vx~1.34, vy~-7.3) past the top-left corner (9.1,5.0) of thin wall. Corner distance shrinks monotonically (+0.21 at 31, +0.09 at 32, -0.032 at 33, -0.156 at 34) while velocity stays downward, so impulse plus positional correction fails to push the circle out of the rounded-corner contact and penetration accumulates past the 0.15 tolerance. Removing horizontal motion avoids the corner and removes the failure.
